Veterans Benefits: Nebraska fully exempts military retired pay from state income tax, offers homestead property-tax exemptions for eligible disabled veterans and surviving spouses, tuition waiver programs for dependents, and operates the Central Nebraska Veterans Home directly in Grand Island.

Description: Central Nebraska city on the Platte River featuring an in-city VA medical center, the Central Nebraska Veterans Home, low living costs, and state income tax exemption on military retired pay. It offers rich outdoors recreation along the Platte River corridor, home to the annual sandhill crane migration, and a strongly conservative regional culture.
